choices.text:
The bug is on line 5: `strncat` stops at the first NUL byte in `tok`, so if the token contains an embedded NUL, only the part before it is copied — the reconstructed SQL token silently truncates. Additionally, `strncat` doesn't respect `sql_cap` (it can overflow the destination buffer), and the length semantics of `strncat`'s `n` (max chars appended, not a bounded copy of a non-terminated source) are misused here. The primary defect — mixing NUL-terminated APIs with a (ptr,len) token that may contain embedded NULs — is introduced at line 5.

Answer: 5
